title: Drill Anvil
wikitext:
The '''Drill Anvil''' is a special kind of [[Anvil]] used to add [[Drill Fuel]] and [[Drills|Drill Parts]] to [[Drills]]. Against its description, it can still be used as a regular [[Anvil]]. Currently there are only {{Green|2}} ways to access the '''Drill Anvil''': 

# Talking to {{NPCSprite|Jotraeline Greatforge}} in {{zone|The Forge}} or calling with an [[Abiphone]].
# Talking to {{NPCSprite|Geonathan Greatforge}} in the {{zone|Crystal Nucleus}}.

Talking to {{NPCSprite|Jotraeline Greatforge}} or {{NPCSprite|Geonathan Greatforge}} requires a [[Drills|Drill]] in the player's inventory.

== Fuel ==
One of the main purposes of the '''Drill Anvil''' is to add fuel to [[Drills]] through any [[Machine Fuel]] source. Hovering over the [[Enchanted Cactus Green]] within the '''Drill Anvil''' interface displays the amount of fuel added for [[Poppy]], [[Dandelion]], [[Goblin Egg]], [[Biofuel]], [[Volta]], and [[Oil Barrel]]. These sources make up only 6 of the accepted 24 different [[Machine Fuel|Machine Fuels]].

== Installing and Removing Drill Parts ==
=== Installing Drill Parts ===
The player can install a [[Drill Part]] by placing a [[Drill]] on the left side of the anvil and a [[Drill Part]] on the right side of the anvil. If the upgrade is possible, the hopper in the middle will begin to glow and the player will be able to view a preview of the upgrade. The upgrade can be confirmed by clicking on the hopper and taking the [[Drills|Drill]] from the anvil.

=== Removing Drill Parts ===
The player can remove a [[Drill Part]], by placing a [[Drills|Drill]] on the left side of the anvil. All currently added [[Drill Parts]] will appear in three slots in the left of the interface. Removing any [[Drill Part]] costs {{Coins|9,999}}. Clicking on any [[Drill Part]] will remove it and return it to the player's inventory.
